message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Red Army** – commanded by General Georgy Zhukov (later Marshal).
• **German Wehrmacht’s Sixth Army** – led initially by Field‑Marshal Friedrich Paulus (later promoted to field marshal after surrender). | | **Location** | City of **Stalingrad** (modern-day *Volgograd*), situated on the eastern bank of the **Don River**, in southwestern Russia. The fighting encompassed the urban area as well as surrounding countryside and river crossings. | This pivotal clash took place from August 1942 until February 1943, marking one of the largest and most decisive battles of World War II.
